resources.string: Each reception from a paired device: what was read and written to Health Connect.
Something stops readings from arriving: permissions, Bluetooth, Health Connect.
device clock not usable, time of reception used
Could not connect to the device. Take another measurement to retry.
The device does not offer the expected Bluetooth service.
Could not subscribe to measurements. The pairing may be gone: check the system\'s Bluetooth settings or pair again.
Health Connect is not available on this phone, so the readings were not written.
Health Connect permissions are missing. Open the app to grant them.
Health Connect refused the readings. Open the app for details.
Bluetooth is off, so the device could not be read.

The background scan stopped. Open the app to register it again.
The background scan could not be registered. Open the app to see why.
Android did not allow reading in the background. Open the app once; then try another measurement.
Bluetooth permissions are missing, so the device could not be read. Open the app to grant them.
Why Health Devices writes health data
Readings from your Bluetooth device (blood pressure and pulse) are written to Health Connect so other apps you allow can see them. Nothing leaves the phone: the app has no network access.
Available, but write permissions are missing.
Health Connect is not available. On Android 12 and 13 the Health Connect app must be installed; from Android 14 it is part of the system.
The Health Connect app needs an update before this app can use it.
Notifications not allowed: you will not see what was read.
Scan registered (%1$s); this phone reports every advertisement, so a device may be contacted more than once.
Scan not registered: Bluetooth is off. It registers itself when Bluetooth turns on.
Scan not registered: no paired device.
Scan not registered: the scanner refused (code %1$d).

The system wakes the app when a paired device advertises after a measurement. It is registered again on boot, when Bluetooth turns on, and whenever this screen opens. After a force-stop (or Samsung\'s "sleeping apps") nothing wakes the app until it is opened again.
Some phones (Samsung in particular) stop background work of apps that are not exempt. Find Health Devices in the list and allow it.
Offers the Current Time Service (not used yet).
Imported up to the device time %1$s.
The device sends a time without a zone; it is read in this zone. A change applies to future readings only.
The app stops reading it. The Bluetooth pairing itself stays until you remove the device in the system\'s Bluetooth settings.
Service not found on the device
Scanning and connecting need the nearby-devices permissions.
Health Connect write permissions are needed before readings can be imported.
Take a measurement now: a blood pressure monitor advertises for about half a minute after each measurement. Then start the scan and tap the device when it appears.
No device yet. If the measurement was a while ago, take another one.
If the phone asks for a pairing code, enter the one the device shows. The device sends its stored readings now; that may take a few seconds.
Import them into Health Connect now
Only new readings from now on
The connection failed (status %1$d). Take another measurement so the device advertises, then retry.
The device does not offer a supported service.
Subscribing to measurements failed (status %1$d). If a pairing dialog was dismissed, retry and accept it.
The device did not answer in time. Take another measurement, then retry.
%1$s is paired. New measurements arrive in the background from now on.
The readings on the device were left alone; only newer ones will be imported.
